newsitem.title: KUWAIT: U.S. firm wins key Kuwait oil project work.
newsitem.headline: U.S. firm wins key Kuwait oil project work.

text.p: Parsons Engineering Corp. signed an $80 million project management contract on Saturday to help Kuwait develop crude oil production capacity, a Kuwaiti oil official said.
Kuwait Oil Co. (KOC), crude oil-producing arm of state-owned oil conglomerate Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC), will put its signature to the contract on Sunday, the official said by telephone.

The project management role assisting KOC develop and expand oil output capacity is central to Kuwait's long-term plans to raise capacity to 3.5 million barrels per day (bpd) by the year 2005 from almost 2.5 million at the moment.
The contract will run for five years from December 1996.
Parsons, of Pasadena, California, was competing against Bechtel, ABB Lummus Global and Foster Wheeler Corp.
